High Water Bank.name: High Water Bank
High Water Bank.description: The user plants both feet on a sandy riverbank and drives loose dry sand along the waterfront in low spirals. Over two turns the user packs a continuous bank as high as a bus along a city block, turning floodwater away from ground-floor doors for the rest of the scene. The user can leave a gap to drain the water onto empty ground. The bank needs sand from the full length of the shore, and any section overtopped by water washes out. Strain: severe.
